t: This is St Andrew-by-the-Wardrobe, a Church of England church on Queen Victoria Street, near Blackfriars station. Today it is also the London headquarters of the Coptic Orthodox Church and home to the Coptic Orthodox Archbishop of London, Archbishop Anba Angaelos, under a church-sharing arrangement. The church was designed by Sir Christopher Wren. After the Great Fire of 1666 he was given responsibility for rebuilding fifty-two City churches, and he went on to complete St Paul's Cathedral in 1710. This is one of that large group of churches.
